run_rms_norm_forward: run RMS normalization on a contiguous torch tensor with optional attention norm weights and epsilon
run_rms_norm_add_forward: run RMS normalization on the sum of two contiguous tensors with optional attention norm weights and epsilon
review_rms_norm_kernel: review the triton jit kernel that performs RMS normalization row-wise over the last dimension
review_rms_norm_add_kernel: review the triton jit kernel that adds two tensors then performs RMS normalization row-wise
test_rms_norm_forward: test the rms norm forward function with contiguous input tensor, optional weights, and epsilon parameter
